_note: Member onboarding and offboarding (member-onboarding-in-plain-words) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages for both registers; schema refs BY SLUG (member-onboarding / member-offboarding), never PascalCase. DECLARATIVE CORE ONLY: the progress dashboard widgets of REQ-MOB-011 (records-per-lifecycle + overdue-steps KPI) belong in the base src/manifest.json Dashboard page (design D6: mergePages replaces a same-id page wholesale, so a fragment cannot add one widget to Dashboard without duplicating it) and are DEFERRED here to keep this change to the two allowed files. The detail-page checklist actions (complete/skip/execute provisioning) and the bulk-intake suggestion list are imperative surfaces also out of core scope; these pages render the record, its steps and its references declaratively.
